extraction.document_summary: Singlife Multipay Critical Illness II is a critical illness policy with multiple payouts across early, intermediate and severe stages, plus additional “extra cushioning” benefits and a death benefit. Under the Critical Illness Benefit, the first early/intermediate diagnosis pays 100% of sum assured per eligible claim (up to 2 claims total and subject to CI limits), while the first severe stage diagnosis pays 150% of sum assured, with a maximum total payout of 600% of sum assured under this benefit. Recurrent Critical Illness Benefit then allows further payouts of 150% per eligible recurrent claim, up to 2 claims (maximum total 300% of sum assured). On a first severe stage diagnosis, premiums are waived and the Advance Care Option can convert the Recurrent Critical Illness Benefit into an extra lump sum equal to 75% of sum assured (and the recurrent benefit terminates). Coverage term is chosen up to age 99 (in one-year intervals) and may be in SGD, USD, GBP, EUR, AUD or HKD.
quality_notes: Core benefit structure (early/intermediate/severe, recurrent, advance care option, extra benefits, death benefit) and key payout caps are stated.
Exact eligibility age limits, underwriting method, and any medical examination requirement are not provided in the brochure.

Full lists of covered conditions are referenced but not included in the document; only counts (e.g., 135 conditions; 34 “Special Benefit” conditions; 6 severe and 60 severe recurrence groups) are given.

policies.quick_summary: Multipay critical illness plan with up to 600% sum assured under the Critical Illness Benefit (early/intermediate/severe stage) and an additional Recurrent Critical Illness Benefit up to 300% (up to 2 recurrent claims). A first severe stage diagnosis triggers premium waiver and may be converted via the Advance Care Option into an extra 75% lump sum, terminating the recurrent benefit. Also provides extra 20% per life for ICU stay of 4+ days, and extra 20% per life per condition for 34 Special Benefit conditions (with a total of up to six claims under that Special Benefit). Includes a S$5,000 death benefit during coverage.
coverage_scope: Critical Illness Benefit covering early, intermediate and severe stage critical illnesses (135 conditions referenced)
Recurrent Critical Illness Benefit for certain specified severe stage conditions and recurrences
Advance Care Option convertible from first severe stage diagnosis to an extra payout and termination of recurrent benefit
Intensive Care Unit (ICU) stay extra benefit (4 days or more) for confirmed necessary medical treatment
Special Benefit extra payout for certain specified conditions (34 conditions referenced)
Death benefit of S$5,000 during coverage period
policies.coverage_term_description: Choice of coverage term from 10 years up to age 99 (in one-year intervals).
policy_termination_events: Critical Illness Benefit ceases once 600% of the Sum Assured is fully paid out
Recurrent Critical Illness Benefit ceases once 300% of the Sum Assured is fully paid out or when the Advance Care Option is successfully exercised, whichever is earlier
Certain extra benefits cease on policy anniversary at age 85 (or earlier upon claim or policy expiry), as described for each extra benefit
important_caveats: Recurrent benefit is terminated when the Advance Care Option is exercised.
Recurrent benefit only applies after the Critical Illness Benefit has ceased, and is subject to waiting/survival period requirements (full details referenced to Product Summary).
The ICU stay benefit requires the ICU stay of 4 days or more (due to illness or accident) to be in one hospital admission in Singapore and confirmed as Necessary Medical Treatment.

benefits.benefit_name: Critical Illness Benefit - Early or Intermediate Stage (per CI Group, one claim allowed per CI Group)
benefits.benefit_description: Upon diagnosis of any one of the specified Early or Intermediate Stage Critical Illnesses (within a CI Group), 100% of the Sum Assured is payable in one lump sum.
benefits.trigger_description: Diagnosis of any one of the covered 75 Early or Intermediate Stage Critical Illnesses (as referenced by the brochure) within the Critical Illness Benefit.
covered_conditions: 75 Early or Intermediate Stage Critical Illnesses (specific list not provided; referenced to Product Summary)
Early and Intermediate Stage critical illnesses covered under this plan
benefits.payout_description: 100% of Sum Assured payable in one lump sum (for Early/Intermediate Stage; subject to CI Benefit total amount payable).
benefits.claim_frequency: Only one claim allowed for the Early and Intermediate Stage of each CI Group covered.
benefits.benefit_start_description: If the Life Assured is diagnosed with any one of the Early or Intermediate Stage Critical Illnesses covered, 100% of the Sum Assured will be payable in one lump sum.
benefits.benefit_expiry_description: This benefit shall cease once the Critical Illness Benefit is terminated.
benefits.notes: Waiting/survival period are applicable (details referenced to Product Summary). Early/intermediate to severe stage: no waiting period from an Early/Intermediate claim to a Severe Stage CI Benefit claim, but there is a one-year waiting period between two Early/Intermediate claims.
